<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|And if she was an Elderspawn who had perfected her disguise to this degree, then as the great strategist Loreli had once said, “Sometimes one is simply beaten.”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|— ''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 17}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Loreli Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Loreli is a legendary figure in [[Imperial]] history, recognized as the original strategist and the founder of the [[Luminian Order]]. While many historical accounts treat her as a scholar or hero from the ancient past, she is actually a contemporary figure who has remained active and serves as the [[Regent of the West]]. She possesses immense natural talent that she developed under the Emperor's guidance, allowing her to extend her awareness across vast distances. Physically, Loreli has a compact, muscular build and a youthful, rounded face that makes her appear much younger than her true age. She is often associated with silver-and-white military-style attire and braided hair, a look that has influenced fashion for centuries. In combat or formal settings, she is depicted in full armor. Beyond her tactical brilliance, she possesses a calming presence capable of soothing others' minds. Her current duties involve managing imperial affairs and hunting [[Great Elders]] to protect the realm.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Loreli is a woman with dark skin and hair styled into a hundred braids. She wears signature silver-and-white armor, and her eyes are capable of flashing white.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A scholar and great strategist from the ancient past, Loreli is a historical hero who once served as a ruler by delegating and appointing other leaders. She acts as an ally to [[Shera]] and a companion to [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin Maze-walker]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Loreli is the daughter of the Emperor and serves as a companion to [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin Maze-walker]]. She acts as an ally to [[Shera]], with whom she once met alongside [[Estyr]]. Additionally, Loreli is a rival of [[Urg’naut]], whose intentions are the direct opposite of her own.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a Reader, Loreli can read people and their possessions. She possesses healing abilities, can radiate an [[aura]] of peace and tranquility, and uses a [[sword]] to produce bolts of pure white lightning.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Ancient Strategist}} ===

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Regent of Luminia}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|As a [[Regent]], Loreli held meetings with the [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c6">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 6</ref> She is recognized as a historical hero and is even depicted within the [[Luminian cathedral]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 8</ref> Loreli joined the group following the period when the Emperor began using that title.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 9</ref> While positioned on the other side of an unspecified location, she recalled a previous encounter where she successfully talked an [[assassin]] out of killing her.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c22">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 22</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Loreli]] is a historical hero depicted in the [[Luminian cathedral]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Loreli]] joined the group after the Emperor began calling himself the Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c9" />}}</li>

{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As part of the deal established by [[Estyr]], Loreli is among those who will step down from their position of rule.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Journey to Izyria}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|After reportedly sneaking off to [[Izyria]], Loreli established herself as a strategist and an ally to [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c9">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref> As the founder of the [[Luminian Order]], she once struck down [[Urg’naut]], possessing an intent that stands in direct opposition to his own.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref> Currently located on the [[Aion Sea]], Loreli serves as a [[Luminian]] [[Regent]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref> Clad in trademark silver-and-white armor, the [[Regent]] can radiate an [[aura]] of peace and tranquility while utilizing healing abilities.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" /> Her powers also include the ability to read people and their possessions.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" /> While being levitated by [[Estyr]], Loreli fell from the sky [[sword]]-first.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Emperor has mentioned Loreli as a person who might still be alive.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c3">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 3</ref> [[Shera]] had previously met with [[Loreli and Estyr]] in a conference room.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref> A message was left within Loreli's weapon.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref> As a [[Regent]], she would be after the [[Consultants]] and functioned as a ruler who appointed other rulers to serve as guides.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref> Loreli is a Reader and the first of the [[Luminian Order]], serving as the [[Regent of the West]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 18</ref> This woman, who was called by [[Estyr]], possesses dark skin and hair styled in a hundred braids.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 19</ref> She is the Daughter of the Emperor and holds the titles of the original [[Pilgrim]] and the original Knight.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Elder War}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|During the [[Elder War]], Loreli successfully landed a fatal blow against the [[Great Elder]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref> While her group was tasked with holding the wheel until her return, [[Shera]] mistakenly believed that Loreli had already joined the battle.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref> Loreli possesses eyes that can flash white and spent her time among the [[Luminian|Luminians]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref> In combat, she utilizes a [[sword]] to produce bolts of pure white lightning.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref>}}
